shown.message:
The new `Outline` revision needed no redraw. The comparison table already carries both references and the leave-one-out class representatives (Tables 1 and 5), and the OLL and HELM aggregates are in Table 7. The Fig. 3 caption already says the difference estimator doesn't fully remove the bias.

Checking the R = 100 files against Table 3 turned up one correction to `experiment-repo`'s "Table 3 does not change". Every entry shown moves by at most 0.02, except uniform × IRT model in extrapolation, where bias² goes from 4.29 to 4.42 and MSE from 4.56 to 4.68. Lineage and the anchor × IRT plug-in row were not re-run at R = 100.

I added an optional sentence on this check to the Table 3 entry in `tables/captions.md` (pushed, 362899e). The paper doesn't mention the R = 100 run yet, so I opened `paper-repo`#11. It leaves it to `paper-repo` whether and where to state it.

`experiment-repo`#2 stays open for the recalibrated-estimator and `extra_*` results, which haven't arrived.
